bull_case_summary: Costco has observed sales, earnings and adjusted comparable-sales growth. Round two preserves comparable-demand strength after excluding the tariff refund and frames the case as durable operations at a justified normalised valuation.
bear_case_summary: The bear accepts demand progress independent of the refund but retains the 44.49x snapshot multiple as an unanswered price hurdle. Debt, FCF and membership economics are unreconciled, and the overbought rebound below SMA-200 does not establish an entry advantage.
key_points_of_agreement: Adjusted comparable-sales growth supports genuine demand.
The $0.15 quarterly tariff-refund benefit is nonrecurring.
Net income/net sales excludes membership fees and is not a consolidated margin.
Business quality does not itself establish current purchase value.
key_points_of_disagreement: How much prospective earnings duration to assign comparable growth before normalised cash valuation is completed.
unresolved_uncertainties: Persistence of comparable-demand growth and normalised membership economics.
Margin for slower growth at the snapshot premium and durable price recovery.
